Write an Esri Tile Package (.tpk or .tpkx) for Offline Field Basemaps

Source: R/vantor_fieldwork.R
vantor_write_tpk.Rd

Generates a multi-zoom Web Mercator (EPSG:3857) Esri Tile Package (.tpk Compact Cache V1 or .tpkx Compact Cache V2) in pure R without requiring proprietary ArcGIS software or ArcGIS Online credits. Designed for zoomable offline satellite basemaps in World Bank Survey Solutions (including v24.09+ built on the ArcGIS Maps SDK for .NET v200.x), ArcGIS Field Maps, and ArcGIS Survey123.

Tiles can either be sliced offline from a local terra::SpatRaster / GeoTIFF (raster), or fetched directly across zoom levels from the Vantor WMS/WMTS imagery service (raster = NULL).

Usage

vantor_write_tpk(
  x = NULL,
  output_file = tempfile(fileext = ".tpk"),
  zoom = 15:17,
  format = c("auto", "tpk", "tpkx"),
  raster = NULL,
  product = "VIVID_STANDARD_30",
  max_tiles = 2500L,
  title = "Vantor Satellite Basemap",
  zip_for_suso = FALSE,
  aoi = NULL,
  verbose = getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE)
)

Arguments

x

Optional spatial object (sf, sfc, bbox, SpatRaster, SpatVector, SpatExtent, stars, or numeric c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax)) defining the Area of Interest. If NULL, the extent of raster is used.

output_file

Character string. Destination file path ending in .tpk or .tpkx. Defaults to tempfile(fileext = ".tpk") in compliance with CRAN policy.

zoom

Integer vector of Web Mercator (EPSG:3857) zoom levels (0 to 22) to render into the tile pyramid. Default is 15:17.

format

Character string: "auto" (inferred from output_file extension), "tpk" (Compact Cache V1 with .bundle + .bundlx and XML metadata), or "tpkx" (Apache-2.0 open specification Compact Cache V2 with .bundle and JSON metadata, supported by ArcGIS Maps SDK v200.x).

raster

Optional terra::SpatRaster or file path to a GeoTIFF raster. When supplied, tiles are resampled offline from raster. When NULL, tiles are downloaded from the Vantor WMS service using active credentials (vantor_auth()).

product

Character string. Vantor Vivid mosaic product identifier when fetching online tiles (raster = NULL). Default is "VIVID_STANDARD_30".

max_tiles

Integer. Safety cap on total tiles across all requested zoom levels to prevent accidental massive downloads. Default is 2500L.

title

Character string. Package title embedded in iteminfo. Default is "Vantor Satellite Basemap".

zip_for_suso

Logical. If TRUE, also creates a clean outer .zip archive (<stem>_tpk.zip or <stem>_tpkx.zip) using zip -q -X -j (stripping macOS __MACOSX/._* resource forks that Survey Solutions Headquarters rejects when users compress files via macOS Finder). Default is FALSE.

aoi

Optional alias for x (Area of Interest).

verbose

Logical. Print progress messages. Default is getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE).

Value

Invisibly returns the normalized output_file path, with attributes n_tiles, zoom, format, and suso_zip_path (when zip_for_suso = TRUE).

Examples

if (requireNamespace("terra", quietly = TRUE)) {
  # Create a synthetic RGB SpatRaster in EPSG:3857
  r <- terra::rast(
    xmin = -11689500, xmax = -11688500,
    ymin = 4826500, ymax = 4827500,
    nrows = 128, ncols = 128, nlyrs = 3,
    crs = "EPSG:3857"
  )
  terra::values(r) <- sample(50:220, terra::ncell(r) * 3, replace = TRUE)

  # Export both .tpk (Compact Cache V1) and .tpkx (Compact Cache V2)
  tpk_file <- vantor_write_tpk(
    raster = r,
    output_file = tempfile(fileext = ".tpk"),
    zoom = 14:15,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  tpkx_file <- vantor_write_tpk(
    raster = r,
    output_file = tempfile(fileext = ".tpkx"),
    zoom = 14:15,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  unlink(c(tpk_file, tpkx_file))
}
